BACKGROUND_Specialist_Aquaculturist_Desc: Created oil-eating fish to clean the ocean. Things got messy when they started infiltrating boats.
BACKGROUND_Specialist_Birdkeeper_Descrip: Turned noisy birds into a crafty salvage crew with nothing but minced fish and low-budget martial arts tapes.
BACKGROUND_Specialist_Chemist_Descriptio: When things go wrong, they don’t freak out. They bottle their emotions, and carry on.
BACKGROUND_Specialist_Electrician_Descri: They once powered an entire house with a kite, a fish, and a really well-timed lightning storm.

Background_CookOfThePlasticSea_Descripti: %NAME% didn’t only survive the flood, it made sure it tasted all the riches of the new world! It’s favorite recipe: A quarter Flounder with cheese.
Background_LandHopper_Description: After the flood %NAME% spent his life hopping island after island with a tiny boat, scavenging for any remains in order to survive.
Background_Past_AthleticsCooking_Descrip: Shake milk, get swole, shake more milk. It's a vicious, delicious cycle.
Background_Past_AthleticsCrafting_Descri: Worked at a landfill, before those all got filled with water.
Background_Past_AthleticsDesalination_De: Eventually, fresh water became a more precious resource than oil. This drifter adapted accordingly.
Background_Past_AthleticsFishing_Descrip: In a stunning display of rage, this olympic angler dove into the water and put their prize fish into a headlock. Changed the sport overnight.
Background_Past_AthleticsNautics_Descrip: They joined a boat crew to find the edge of the world. The first floods didn't interrupt that plan, so they kept on sailing. They're still searching, to this day.
Background_Past_AthleticsResearch_Descri: Crash-landed a year after the first floods. Still doesn't quite understand what happened while they were gone.
Background_Past_AthleticsSalvaging_Descr: Infamously strong garbage custodian. Hurled trash bins with the force of a small explosion.
Background_Past_Athletics_Description: Held a championship title in both volleyball and water polo at the same time. Insisted the sports were, "Basically the same thing," to widespread anger and gnashing of teeth.
Background_Past_ConstructionAthletics_De: Building dams is all well and good, until the water comes from the other side and ruins the whole thing.
Background_Past_ConstructionCooking_Desc: Built a food truck with their bare hands and spare parts. Terrifying level of improvisation.
Background_Past_ConstructionCrafting_Des: Used to build model trains, and miniature cities for the trains to travel across. That's all gone, now.
Background_Past_ConstructionDesalination: Once the polar caps melted, it seemed a bit useless to chip ice into shapes. There's no ice left, for starters, which makes the job slightly more difficult.
Background_Past_ConstructionFishing_Desc: Used their experience operating cranes to win the best prizes in arcade claw games. Eventually banned.
Background_Past_ConstructionNautics_Desc: Lighthouses seemed less useful after the first flood. They stepped off of the top platform into a conveniently-placed boat, and never looked back.
Background_Past_ConstructionResearch_Des: Tried to stop the first floods. Failed.
Background_Past_ConstructionSalvaging_De: After the first floods washed away their home, they found shelter in any places they could.
Background_Past_Construction_Description: Did you know that you can make a house of cards that's seventy-eight stories tall? Yeah, they don't know either. Didn't stop them from trying, though.
Background_Past_CookingFishing_Descripti: Fished from drowned building gutters during the first floods. Also, gutted the fish.
Background_Past_CookingSalvaging_Descrip: Redefined the meaning of 'junk food' by making gourmet meals from discarded leftovers.
Background_Past_Cooking_Description: They believed crickets were the next big superfood before the first floods, and they would NOT shut up about it.
Background_Past_CraftingCooking_Descript: Award-winning creator of spaghetti bridges, meatball golems, and other culinary marvels.
Background_Past_CraftingFishing_Descript: You can make ladders for fish. You can even make tubes for fish! However, it takes a true visionary to transport fish safely via cannon.
Background_Past_CraftingResearch_Descrip: They were SO ready for the apocalypse... as long as it was zombie-related.
Background_Past_CraftingSalvaging_Descri: The type of person who would watch you drink a soda, so they could grab the empty can and turn it into a wind chime.
Background_Past_Crafting_Description: Recycling didn't fail - people did. They had an easy route to avoiding the first floods, and kept creating mountains of trash anyway. This drifter tries not to be resentful. They hold onto hope.
Background_Past_DesalinationCooking_Desc: Experienced brewer with discriminating tastes. Survived the first floods, because they didn't follow the MAIN STREAMS.
Background_Past_DesalinationCrafting_Des: Sometimes, they think about how much plastic crap they had to remove from pipes and plumbing. This all could have been avoided.
Background_Past_DesalinationFishing_Desc: Is there a more efficient method of fishing than draining a lake and collecting the fish from the bottom? No. No, there is not.
Background_Past_DesalinationResearch_Des: You want to know the difference between spring water, mountain water, fresh water, and water (with added electrolytes)? This is who you ask.
Background_Past_DesalinationSalvaging_De: Would drink practically anything for higher ratings - including their own urine. It was a different time.
Background_Past_Desalination_Description: There is nothing in this world more exciting than water - NOTHING. And this drifter knows it.
Background_Past_FishingSalvaging_Descrip: In a previous life, this fisher would catch nothing but boots, tires, and cans. They do the same thing now - but everyone loves it, all of a sudden. Weird.
Background_Past_Fishing_Description: Before the first floods, they fished for an entirely different, equally valuable resource: compliments.
Background_Past_NauticsCooking_Descripti: The first floods caught them on shore leave, and they swore to never again leave their boat. Makes fantastic smoothies. Despises everything non-bouyant.
Background_Past_NauticsCrafting_Descript: A former boatswain and current teller of exaggerated nautical tales.
Background_Past_NauticsDesalination_Desc: One night, while sailing through a lightning storm, a freak accident caused this drifter to fuse with the salt spray they spent a lifetime treading! They are in horrible pain, all of the time.
Background_Past_NauticsFishing_Descripti: They fished alone. They sailed alone. Loneliness became a habit.
Background_Past_NauticsResearch_Descript: Kept having to remove garbage from whale blowholes. Got so fed up that they invented a new, whale-friendly form of garbage.
Background_Past_NauticsSalvaging_Descrip: Used to crawling across ships, taking them apart to become something new.
Background_Past_Nautics_Description: In the most embarrassing boating accident ever recorded, this drifter managed to sail the world's largest cruise ship into the planet's last iceberg.
Background_Past_ResearchCooking_Descript: Their exacting eye for safety and innovation in the kitchen made them a treasure, and a scourge. Depends on who you ask.
Background_Past_ResearchFishing_Descript: Surprising knowledge of market trends and human psychology. Made video thumbnails, which taught them a thing or two about baiting.
Background_Past_ResearchSalvaging_Descri: Trapped in a sarcophagus during the first floods, they have intimate experience with the taste of mummy jerky. Sometimes, they miss it.
Background_Past_Research_Description: Agile on land and sea, growing up after the first floods gave them a fresh perspective on how to approach this new, watery world.
Background_Past_Salvaging_Description: Has extremely detailed opinions about metal detectors, and metal detecting accessories.
Background_PreFloodRenownedCaptain_Descr: In a former life, %NAME% was the Captain of the world’s largest ship. It sailed all over the world until it collided with the last Iceberg on the planet.
Background_PreFloodRuralLibrarian_Descri: Before the world washed all the books away, %NAME% was a librarian in a small, cozy little town.
Background_Present_AthleticsCooking_Desc: You can juice anything, this drifter insists. The disturbingly effective results they get seems to suggest that they have a point.
Background_Present_AthleticsCrafting_Des: Tried running on water using wooden shoes. It worked, but the wood was needed elsewhere.
Background_Present_AthleticsDesalination: Dancing between the rain is a useful skill, especially when the rain is made from thundering torrents of acidic pellets as a garbagestorm rages overhead.
Background_Present_AthleticsFishing_Desc: They crack open mussels with their bare hands, wrestling them open to feel something - anything.
Background_Present_AthleticsNautics_Desc: Occasionally, they'll disappear for a couple of weeks and come back with treasures from a distant land. You never know when. They never say where.
Background_Present_AthleticsResearch_Des: With a single breath, this drifter explores sunken ruins, skyscrapers, and other structures located next to reasonably convenient sources of air!
Background_Present_AthleticsSalvaging_De: In a flooded society, wreckage delvers are the closest thing we have to archivists. They preserve the world before, and you can get a piece for a small, suitable fee.
Background_Present_Athletics_Description: As silent as they are strong, this drifter lets their muscles speak for them.
Background_Present_ConstructionAthletics: You really think that some change in 'climate' could raise the sea level by 25 stories? WAKE UP! Aliens dumped sewage on our planet! The aristocracy are enjoying their sunken pleasure bunkers as we speak!!!
Background_Present_ConstructionCooking_D: The definition of someone playing with their food, they build houses out of pineapples, and drop them to the bottom of the sea. Unfortunate, but hopefully SOMETHING gets a use out of it.
Background_Present_ConstructionCrafting_: If the stories are true, this drifter can make a rope out of just about anything. Bark, seaweed, bottles... I heard they lashed together a boardwalk using human hair, once.
Background_Present_ConstructionDesalinat: Salt is easier to find than ever, but if you're looking for the GOOD STUFF, you need an expert. This is your expert.
Background_Present_ConstructionFishing_D: Is creating dynamite from spare chemicals and chucking it into the ocean efficient, or sane? Not really. It looks cool, though.
Background_Present_ConstructionNautics_D: They're a bit of a blowhard, but their knowledge of fluid dynamics and wind resistance makes them an invaluable part of a seafaring crew.
Background_Present_ConstructionResearch_: Collage-based art installations are a dozen times more ambitious, now that the resources of the entire WORLD are up for grabs. They dream of eventually getting their hands on a blimp.
Background_Present_ConstructionSalvaging: Every building is a mixtape, and this drifter can't wait to find the next groovy combination.
Background_Present_Construction_Descript: Where you see garbage, they see walls, infrastructure, and a new way of life. It's a pleasant perspective.
Background_Present_CookingFishing_Descri: With a new world, come new culinary riches. This drifter's favorite recipe is a quarter-flounder with cheese.
Background_Present_CookingSalvaging_Desc: Canning is more important than ever, after the floods. While many traditional methods are no longer possible (or useful), this drifter is at the forefront of preserved experimentation and cuisine.
Background_Present_Cooking_Description: They claimed to be a famous chef in the world before. We can't really disprove it, so why not play along?
Background_Present_CraftingCooking_Descr: Stranded on a small, inhospitable island in the early days of the flood, this drifter eventually found their way back to humanity. However, freedom came at a dire cost: the loss of their round, ball-shaped friend.
Background_Present_CraftingFishing_Descr: Even if we'll eat the fish later, making them comfortable with a nice woolen net crafted from strong, cushioned material just feels humane.
Background_Present_CraftingResearch_Desc: They crafted a diving bell from a plastic watch, three mussels, and 24 discarded restaurant straws. It allowed them to survive on the seafloor for literal weeks. They are my hero.
Background_Present_CraftingSalvaging_Des: They know what pile that hunk of plastic belongs to; what tower of cans this aluminum cylinder fits like a purpose-made glove... Their organization skills are inherent, and unmatched. Fear them.
Background_Present_Crafting_Description: You can build anything with scrap, if you're persistent enough. And weird. This drifter is both!
Background_Present_DesalinationCooking_D: One week in a toppled satellite dish OPENED THEIR MIND. From home-cooked recipes to interstellar signals, this drifter is filled with the knowledge of the cosmos - and every sitcom episode ever produced.
Background_Present_DesalinationCrafting_: Will get fresh water for their companions by any means necessary - including melting ice with their own precious body heat. Truly selfless.
Background_Present_DesalinationFishing_D: It's not quite dignified, but sucking the moisture from anemones and sea sponges was enough to get this drifter through several garbage storms.
Background_Present_DesalinationResearch_: Keeping a little salt in your pockets will ward off ghosts, spirits, and other assorted apparitions. Keeping a LOT of salt in your pockets will have the opposite effect, and quickly becomes very unpleasant.
Background_Present_DesalinationSalvaging: They bobbed in the ocean for three days, just to learn how salt reacts with the human body. A nearly fanatical dedication to discovering the edge of human limitations... and never doing that again.
Background_Present_Desalination_Descript: "There's moisture all around us," this drifter insists with a sparkle in their eyes. "On the side of this boat! In this discarded can! Jiggling around in your body! Wait, where are you go--"
Background_Present_FishingSalvaging_Desc: Every part of the fish is VALUABLE. The SCALES can be turned into colorful mosaics. The EYES can be used for telescope lenses. The MEAT... well, it's just meat, but it's still cool, right?
Background_Present_Fishing_Description: It turns out yummy-looking plastic makes an incredible bait for deep water fishing. This drifter particularly favors the sides of detergent bottles.
Background_Present_NauticsCooking_Descri: They used to roam the rising seas as a pirate. However, a series of unfortunate, extremely flammable accidents has led them to a new calling: smoking fish.
Background_Present_NauticsCrafting_Descr: An experienced raft builder, who only gained more practical knowledge as the flood waters continued to rise. Their signature is a little heart-shaped knot in every major joint. Boats built with love.
Background_Present_NauticsDesalination_D: Sinks, blowup pools, bathtubs - if it is vaguely circular, and even somewhat bouyant, this drifter will ride it into the sunset.
Background_Present_NauticsFishing_Descri: Stranded inside of a whale for months, this drifter managed to fix their ship with plastic eaten by the whale, and sail right back out. Technically, this contribution to animal health makes them a veterinarian.
Background_Present_NauticsResearch_Descr: They claim to be able to control boats from a distance, but they refuse to demonstrate this ability. At least the name's cool.
Background_Present_NauticsSalvaging_Desc: With just one tiny boat, this drifter crossed oceans. There isn't much left, on the fragments of land remaining - but if you're persistent, there's enough to survive.
Background_Present_Nautics_Description: The adrenaline rush of a garbagestorm is second-to-none. When they aren't helping the crew steer, they're out on the high seas, chasing their destiny.
Background_Present_ResearchCooking_Descr: Drinking directly from the ocean is generally recognized as a bad idea. However, this is a connoisseur we're talking about. They have nothing to fear from the tangy palette of the Northern water, or the slightly oily aftertastes of the Southern seas.
Background_Present_ResearchFishing_Descr: Works the books, and the hooks. Desperately lonely.
Background_Present_ResearchSalvaging_Des: They don't know what a toaster does, or why it makes that horrible popping sound when you drop it into the ocean - but by golly, they're going to find out.
Background_Present_Research_Description: Garbology: the chief science of a flooded world, adrift with human waste. Reusing garbage to build cleaner, better lives isn't easy, but it's the only way forward.
Background_Present_Salvaging_Description: Taking apart nearly every single thing you touch was once seen as a moral failing. Now, it's a valuable skill! Funny how that changes.
Background_Specialist_Architect_Descript: Once in the niche field of houseboat renovation, their waterproofing expertise propelled them to one of the most sought-after architects of the flooded world.
Background_Specialist_Astronaut_Descript: Went to space to develop fusion power... But was too late to stop the floods.
Background_Specialist_Botanist_Descripti: Growing saplings in a salty environment is nigh impossible, and could only succeed with incubation in a lush ginger beard.
Background_Specialist_Chef_Description: As a master of seafood cuisine, they were grateful when the flood brought ingredients straight into their kitchen.
Background_Specialist_Doctor_Description: Years of experience as a plastic surgeon turned out to be the ultimate preparation for the plastic apocalypse.
Background_Specialist_Engineer_Descripti: Using only a string of seaweed, rusty spoon and a bit of elbow grease, they managed to make an entire ship run on stale coffee.
Background_Specialist_Farmer_Description: From sprouting potatoes in soda cans to training tomatoes to climb up a mast, they always found a way to farm.
Background_Specialist_RadioTechnician_De: Used to spend countless late nights drowning in wires to keep an entire city on air, now they're just trying to stay afloat in a city on water.

CONSTRUCTION_SpaceshipFabricator_Descrip: Fabricates the parts required to build a spaceship.

A scrappy lightship built to keep going after the flood.

Construction_Unbottler_Description: This building unbottles fish to clean some of the pollution.

Construction_WatchTower_Description: The Watch Tower will increase the visibility radius on the Map.

DIALOG_Encounter_FirstScoutingLandmark_L: I bet if we climb to the top, we'll see all sorts of junk beggin' for upscalin'.
DIALOG_Encounter_LocationMarked_001: Alright, I've marked it on the Map.
DIALOG_Encounter_LocationMarked_002: I've marked them on the Map.
DIALOG_Encounter_LocationScouted_Drifter: Captain! Smoke up ahead! Could it be a survivor?
We should check it out, just in case. We could sure use an extra set of hands!
Captain, we spotted signs of life. There might be a survivor out there!
DIALOG_Encounter_LocationScouted_Scout_R: An Old Church! It seems like a good vantage point to scout the region from above. Let's head there.
DIALOG_QUEST_Main_ActivateOzoneShield_Ac: Ozone Shield activated! Let's head for the continent, Captain!
DIALOG_QUEST_Main_ActivateOzoneShield_De: Alright, let me know when you're ready to head to the continent!
DIALOG_QUEST_Main_ActivateOzoneShield_Li: Are you sure you want to activate the Ozone Shield now? There is no going back once it is active.
DIALOG_Quest_Encounter_RadioTechnician_L: Hold on... look, over there! That's an old Radio Station. It seems to be falling apart, but it might just have the equipment that we need to find others.
Look! There's someone on that landmark jumping and waving at us! A survivor!
Can't believe it, I've been stranded here ever since the great flood.
Imagine my surprise when I saw your boa- Wait... Holy Mackeroli... that's no boat! Is that A FLOATING TOWN?!
That is AMAZING! You... wouldn't happen to have room for one more, would you? I'm kinda stranded here.
What a fantastic little haven you've got here!
Hold on.. are you actually going around saving people and building this community together? Is that your thing?
Well, ROCK ON! I think I can help with that!
See, I've spent my life on air: chasing hidden frequencies, broadcasting secrets and spreading vibes. If anyone's out there sending signals, I'll hear them!
So, how about it? With my Radio Equipment and your supplies we can build {[COMMUNITYNAME]}'s very own Radio Station!
Captain! This is exactly what we've been looking for! Let's do this!
Well, would you look at that, our very own Radio Station! It's a beauty, Captain. With this we'll be picking up signals in no time.
DIALOG_Quest_Encounter_RadioTechnician_R: Heck yeah! I'll grab my Radio Equipment and be right there!
Aww man... I had a great idea for an adventure...
Captain, are you sure about this? This person might be able to help us find others. We should give him a chance!
DIALOG_Quest_Encounter_Rescue_Deny_001: I get it... One more mouth to feed.
DIALOG_Quest_Encounter_SupermarketMeetup: A campfire! And it's still smoldering. We just missed 'em!
If they're on the move, they'll be looking for food and water. Let's check the usual spots--see if we catch up.
Movement! Over there, in the supermarket!
WHOA HUH WHAT?! You scared the salt off me!
Take it easy! We were passing through and found your campfire. We wanted to see if you're okay.
Sorry, haven't seen anyone in a while. Didn't expect company while I was munching on crumbs here.

You got your bags packed, food stocked...
Drifting, or heading somewhere?
I'm hopping islands, towards a city further out. Hoping I'll find other people, make surviving less lonely, y'know?

But hey-- Looks like you found me first!
Who are you folks, anyway?
We're a township, {[COMMUNITYNAME]}. We've been driftin' around looking for survivors.
Hold up. You're telling me... I can join you lot?
Oh buoy! This is gonna be great!
Mind giving me a hand with this food? We could use it for the journey ahead.
DIALOG_Quest_EndingContinent_CrossingThe: We've crossed into the Polluted Stream! Air's thick with toxins... visibility dropping fast. Thankfully, the Ozone Shield is stable.
Even through the shield, I can taste the air. Like microwaved flip-flops... and it's chewy.
The sky's melting. Thick and pale, like sour milk pouring into the ocean. It's... mesmerizing. Delicious. Wait, what? What am I saying?
I think those plastic bottles are waving at me... Uhh... Captain, please tell me we're almost there.

<size=105%>OH! I SEE IT!</size> I've always wanted to say this:
<size=120%>LAND HO!</size>
DIALOG_Quest_Main_Astronaut_Rescue_Accep: The Fusion Core's intact, and in better shape than you by the looks of it. But it's buried in the wreckage... it'll take some time to extract.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_Astronaut_Rescue_Line0: Spaceship in sight! Initiating docking maneu... v...
DOCKING SUCCESFUL! Still breathing, floating and safely tucked into the spaceship!
Fusion Core secured. Initiating return sequence. Counting down... 3... 2... 1... Takeoff!
Look up! The sky is alive! {[ASTRONAUT]} is flying her way home!
Captain! The Guidance system's gone. I can't steer her anymore! She's flying in blind!
I can make it! Manual controls... on. Prepar- for emergen- landin- Khhzzt-
She's... She's going down! Over the horizon! {[ASTRONAUT]}... Oh no...
Gh.. 9 outta 10 flight... Slight hiccup at landing, right? R-right?
{[ASTRONAUT]}! This is no time for jokes! You're hurt, stay still.
T... Told you I'd make it.
{[ASTRONAUT]} and the Fusion Core successfully retrieved, Captain!
L-Let's build ourselves a Fusion Reactor!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_FusionReactor_Line002: Earth's first Fusion Reactor... Clean energy made with recycled trash. It's beautiful.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_FusionReactor_Line003: Now to construct the Ozone Shield. Should be a piece of cake with infinite Eel-ectricity! I've added the recipe to the Advanced Eel-ectro Crafter.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_FusionReactor_Line004: This is it... Let's connect it to the Fusion Reactor's grid.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_FusionReactor_Line005: Captain, look: The Ozone Shield, it's working!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_FusionReactor_Line006: We can finally cross the Polluted Stream to the continent!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line001: Beep. Beep. Beep. BEEEEP. BEEEEP. BEEEEP. Beep. Beep. Beep.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line002:
The signal seems to be morse code.
<size=120%>"Stranded... Space... Signal... Weak"</size>
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line003: Whoa, someone's still floating around up there?!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line004: Poor soul's trying to communicate, but we're stuck with this dinky antenna. No way to respond with this setup.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line005: Back in my day, I built a BEAST of a Radio Transmitter that easily reached halfway across the globe. It's not far. If we get it, we might make contact!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line006: Here we are, Captain. My old home. The Broadcasting Tower is up ahead! Let's make our way there.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line007: Goodness, I spent countless late nights drowning in these wires, scaling the mast, connecting satellites, and keeping the signals humming...
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line008: There it is, up top! The Radio Transmitter!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line009: But the whole bottom is flooded. No chance we're getting up that way.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line010: We'll have to stack Ladders to reach it.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line011: Yesssss that's it! That's the transmitter!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_RadioTower_Line012: Let's use this beast to upgrade our Radio Station!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line001: That capsule hit the water like a nibbler in a blender. We'll need to piece it back together. I've added the recipes to the Scrapsmith.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line002: We got the Spaceship Launch Pad! Now we just need...
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line003: A Guidance System to safely land it. And Life Support, for obvious reasons...
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line004: Then there's a Heat Shield so the shuttle doesn't burn up on re-entry. Plus Cold Storage to keep the Fusion Core itself stable.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line005: And of course, you can't launch a rocket without Booster and fuel to power them.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line007: {[ASTRONAUT]}, breathe. We've got this. Step by step! It's not Rocket Scie... Wait.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line008: You truly are my favorite Earthlings.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipBase_Line009: Spaceship Fabricator's ready. Space-shipbuilding starts now! Check out some of the workshops, I've added a few recipes we'll need.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_Boost: That'll get it up in orbit in no time! Or explode. Preferably not explode.
And you doubted me when I said Bio-Waste makes a great accelerant.
I REALLY don't want to know how you learned that...
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_Cockp: For the Guidance System, we'll need a Cockpit Interface. I've added it to the Advanced Eel-ectro Crafter.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_ColdS: The colder the better. Can't have the Fusion Core melting down mid-flight!
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_Guida: There! That should be just enough knobs and switches to control the shuttle's descent.
I hope they make a big, chunky "click" when I flip them.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_HeatS: Shuttle's all set for orbital re-entry!
Great! Don't want to be extra-crispy by the time I land.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_LifeS: Life Support is complete! You can breathe easy now, {[ASTRONAUT]}.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_Quest: All parts bolted, wires crossed. We're go for launch!
Wow. To think, in a couple hours we'll be talking face-to-face, not just over airwaves.
We can't wait to meet you, {[ASTRONAUT]}.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_Rocke: Oh, and regular oil won't cut it... We'll need Rocket Fuel! I've added it the Oil Refinery.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_SpaceshipModules_Space: Space travel requires food that can be tightly packed. I've added a Space Meal recipe to the Fryer.
DIALOG_Quest_Main_TriangulatePosition_Li: A little twist here... swap these two wires... kick the amplifier, aaaand...
Greetings from {[COMMUNITYNAME]}! Receiving your signal loud and clear. Who am I speaking to?
Thank the stars! My name is {[ASTRONAUT]}. I was researching Fusion Power when I lost contact with mission control...
But I've never heard of {[COMMUNITYNAME]}.
That's 'cause we built it! We started with just a tugboat and trash. Now we’re a whole community!
Ripper! How do you power it? Is saltwater an effective conductor? Oh, I'm rambling! Are you from the continent?
THERE'S A CONTINENT?! We've only seen ocean and scraps of land. How do we get there?
I can see it from up here! I can help calculate a route, but first I would need to triangulate your position.
Sail close to a few large metal structures: Pylons, Factories, Ship Wrecks... I'll bounce your signal off them and pinpoint where you are.
There's a pylon on the horizon, we could use it as a starting point.
Signal locked at starting point! Other locations in sight.
Another ping secured!
Nice! Another location locked in!

Triangulation complete! Let's see where you are...
Huh. Uh-oh.
Uh-oh...?
Between you and the continent is the Polluted Stream: a current of pure, toxic pollution. The smog alone makes it completely impassable. Unless...
Unless you build an Ozone Shield strong enough to protect your entire town!
HOWEVER, to continuously run an Ozone Shield over long distances, you'll need to generate as much energy as a dwarf star.
That's... gonna be difficult.
But not impossible. My research into fusion power was too late to stop the Floods, but I got one Fusion Reactor built. The one powering my ship!
Wait.. You've had an infinite energy source all this time?!
Well, yes. It's how I maintain a habitable environment. But the rest of the crew took the return shuttle when the first floods hit. I stayed behind...
So you're saying.. We gotta build a Spaceship now?!
With my help! I'm using the triangulation to send my old cargo capsule down. It's not suitable for manned flight, but will provide the base resources for construction!
Please retrieve it!
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Aquaculturist_Ba: Excuse me, Captain? I've noticed we rely on wild-caught fish to feed the town. It must be horribly time-consuming. Let's build a Fish Farm, so I can teach you how to breed our aquatic friends.
You're not gonna make us eat some weird, mutant fish, are you?
You can raise any type of fish you like. Personally, I have a soft spot for Gobblers. Thick, cute, and tasty!
Captain, look: Our little Gobblers have reached maturity. They grow up so fast... and taste so delicious!
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Aquaculturist_Di: Hello?! Do you Copy? This is {[CURRENT_SPEAKER]}! I've picked up your signal. Listen carefully: you need to shut down your engine IMMEDIATELY! There are Oil Gobblers near, they'll pick up the scent!
Hey! We're an eel-ectrical vessel. No oil, no problem.
Oooh, smart! I haven't seen a ship in months. Been stuck out here breeding fish to survive, but supplies are running thin. Could you get me some?
I need Gobbler Chow. It used to be easy to make, but ever since the agricultural collapse, it's been more difficult. If the flood did not swallow it, there should be a Fish Bait Shack nearby!
Ah-ha! My little Gobblers will feast like kings! Come on over!
Do you like my little Gobblers? I designed them to clean oil spills... and then they evolved. Now they gobble up any oil they find. Especially from boats.
Only if you smell like oil. Anyway, got a spot for an aquaculturist with questionable ethics?
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Architect_Basics: Good grief. I count 37 code violations and not a care in sight. Must be nice.
I can help bring structure to this town. But I'll need a proper workspace. Build me an Architect Station, preferably somewhere stable.

A desk, a chair, and that familiar blue paper. Perfect.
Now, let's talk... everything else.
With Architect Mode, you can make space, untangle any mess you've created, or just move a building or two. I'll be here to supervise.
It's a start, but I'm sure we can do better. Come back when you have fresh ideas. Artistry is achieved through iteration!
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Architect_Produc: This is a recorded broadcast... Humanitarian aid requested... Urgent need of flood-resistant materials. Will monitor frequency for response. Repeat, this is a recorded broadcast...

Uh-oh, sounds like they're in dire straits!
This is {[COMMUNITYNAME]}. We received your request for aid. Tell us how to help!
{[COMMUNITYNAME]}? Do you have a construction license? Doesn't matter, we'll have to cut corners to act in time.
The floods are encroaching on the historic Mystic-Llama Cathedral. I'm building a sea wall to keep the waves at bay, but I'm running low on materials.
<size=120%>EXACTLY</size>. It is a testament to human ingenuity, a monument for future generations to look upon in wonder. We must protect it at all costs.
I'll need Sea Wall pieces. I've sent over schematics. Follow them PRECISELY. I suggest procuring a Hydraulic Press, if you don't have one already.
We have the resources to build the sea wall!
About time. Transferring my coordinates. Don't dawdle. Water levels are rising by the day.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Architect_Rescue: Finally. Even if a hurricane were to strike, that sea wall should hold. Thank you, Captain. You've made an adequate apprentice.
I'll admit, I'm absolutely fascinated by this floating town of yours. Coming aboard.
What are you waiting for? The tides wait for no one.
You have the resources? At least you're reliable, if not punctual.
Help me stand these up. I'm trained to design structures, not construct them.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Birdkeeper_Basic: To begin the winged path, one needs to build a Birdhouse and provide a steady flow of Bird Chow. Seagulls work best on a full belly.
Great work, Captain. Now we need additional recruits. The open sea holds wings in need of rescue. Save them, the flock will grow.
They are now our flock. Our students. They see this town and do not flee. It is a sign of respect. You've earned their trust, and mine. I now walk among peers, Captain-Sensei.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Birdkeeper_Distr: Then my student you shall be. The birds call me... Sensei. You may do the same.
Did the birds really give you that name?
You choose to stumble in the dark, when I have offered a lamp. But life moves in cycles... perhaps our paths will cross again.
AVIAN ANOMALY DETECTED. Perimeter breach in zones 4, 2 and 0. DRONE F4-55, R89 and W34 unresponsive. Retreating for diagnostics. This message will self-repeat.
Avian anomaly what now? Did birds just take down someone's advanced security? That could be terrifying... or valuable. I've got their coordinates.
WATCH OUT! THAT GULL'S GUNNING FOR YOUR HEAD!
Stand down, Steven. These ones carry no greed.
Did... did you just command that seagull?
Command? No. We reached understanding. You must learn to respect the peck. Only then will you know peace.
Right... Well, uh... Can you teach us? We could use such wisdom in our town.
A flock need fish to eat and a place to roost. If you provide, I will guide you along the winged path.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Botanist_Basics_: These plants, they have much to give us, but we must return their hospitality in kind. A Seed Bank would make a fine dwelling.
Now that our Seed Bank is completed, let us go partake in Nature's bounty!
Thank you for your gifts, little ones.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Botanist_Distres: Ah, hear the whispering of the leaves. The plants approve. Onward!
I see... Perhaps the plants intend for me to join you another time.
"Chlorophyll levels steady. Suspected seawater tolerance increasing by 0.3%. Sunflower Jake shows signs of laughter when exposed to banjo music. Might try Jazz tomorrow."
Captain, picking up something odd. Some kind of 'Botanical Field Reports.' It's bouncing in from... the woods?
There's  just a bunch of plants here? They seem to be moving in... sine waves? Huh, wait, the signal is changing!
"Lost two today. Tully and Tilly. Roots couldn’t handle the air pollution. They fought well. Planted their bulbs in a quieter spot. Just in case they try again."
More plants. They're doing the same dance! The signal is stronger than before!
"Oxygen output's up, wilt index down. Sunlight filtering helped! They're growing stronger every day."
Easy now, little sprouts. They're strangers, not herbivores... Probably.
Are... Are you talking to that plant? We've come here because we heard your signals. Your field reports?
My diary? I've been recording it on this little device. It has brought you to me? A moving town. Oh I see, the plants have plans for me.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Chef_Cookbook_Li: "I will share with you the recipes I created in these flooded times: something basic, something weird, something sweet, and something divine."
"Recipe 1: Jelly Fishballs. Sometimes you just need something simple, a quick bite that doesn't involve carefully picking bits of plastic from your teeth. That's when you need Jelly Fishballs."
Well Captain, that sounds great! I've added the Jelly Fishballs recipe to the Fryer, let's make some!
Whoa, these Jelly Fishballs are a treat! Who knew something so simple could taste this good? What's next? I'm so ready for more.

"Recipe 2: Plastic-Wraps. For this one.. keep an open mind. In my exploration of flooded cuisine, I stumbled upon something unexpected: when soaked in saltwater, chemicals from plastics provide a big burst of flavor!"
"You'll get diseased eating it, but boy, it's oozing with flavor. Literally."
I'm not sure about this one, Captain... Nevertheless, I've added the Plastic-Wraps recipe to the Food Truck.
Okay, I'll admit it... that was unexpectedly delicious! Now I'm really curious about what's next. Let me grab the book!
"Now for a special treat, recipe 3: Ocean Taffy. I've always had a sweet tooth, so in the event of a flood, I want to be sure to have a backup."
This sounds delicious, Captain! I've added a Corn Syrup recipe to the Bio-Boiler, and the Ocean Taffy recipe to the Salad Spinner. Can't wait to try it!
M-mouth.. lips.. stuck together... So good. So so good. Mhmhm! Alright, just one recipe left!
"In all my years alive, I've only once eaten something truly divine. It happened when I was but a dishwasher, minding my own business, tossing out the day's dirty water..."
"I noticed a creature so sacred, it seemed as though nature itself birthed it from the depths of trash to restore balance to the world. It was... the Holy Mackerel."
"It thrives only in the dirtiest of waters, and I will quest all my life to taste its divinity once more. The final recipe: Holy Mackeroli."
Captain, this sounds too good to miss out on. I can't help but think of the Sewage Plant. It's basically a collection of dirty water. Let's go see if there's any there!
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Chef_DistressSig: LOW-ENERGY WARNING: Freezer energy reserve at 4%. Recommend immediate attention.
That's a maintenance ping from a restaurant freezer. Back in the day, the fancy places had smart units like this. If it's still humming, it might be holding food!
Well I’ll be chilled. That’s a lot of tomatoes. Like, a lot a lot. They must have frozen them before the shortage. Oh, huh. What's that book over there?
Captain, I stumbled upon this huge book titled "In Flavor of a Flood." Written by someone named "{[CHEF]}."
The book is... odd. The language and scribbles are all over the place, but it's full of ideas for cooking food in our current predicament. The writer truly explored flooded cuisine.
We might discover new recipes if we follow it's steps. Let's see... In Flavor of a Flood, page 1..
Hurrah! My mouth waters in anticipation.
I see... You must lack faith.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Chef_HolyMackere: Shh... Quiet, now. You'll scare the holy mackerels.
It can't be... But it is. It's you! {[CHEF]}! Wait, you actually live here?
Of course. My body’s beyond polluted, but that’s the price I pay for tasting perfection.
We've been following the recipes in your book, they are legendary in {[COMMUNITYNAME]}! We're currently trying the final recipe, the Holy Mackeroli.
Have you now? Impressive. That floating town of yours must be something special. Perhaps this is the second time destiny calls me.
But my equipment is dull and rusted. Furnish me with a Fancy Restaurant, and I'll cook us the finest Holy Mackeroli ever made.
Aha, it's been ages since I had a proper restaurant! This will do nicely. Let's prepare ourselves a divine meal.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Chemist_Basics_L: Before we rig up our oil production pipeline, I'll need a Chemical Lab. We'll use it to refine Coolant, which is vital for keeping the refinery from melting down... The town.
Ahh, smells like home, potential, and accidental explosions. Let's brew up some Coolant and build ourselves an Oil Refinery.
Toss me some plastic and stand back! We're about to turn trash into Black Gold!
Upcycled Oil, from ocean spew. Efficient, elegant... circular.
And it burns just as strong!
You get used to the smog. Entire generations lived and died breathing this stuff!
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Chemist_Distress: Alas, I had such high hopes.
Toxxen Telemetry Barrel #TB547 - Status: Active - Contents: Plastic 34 units ; Oil 611 units - Degradation rate: 0.08 units/hr
It's a data ping. It's tracking some kind of chemical breakdown process. Plastic seems to be degrading... fast. Someone set this up. Might be worth checking out.
Found it! 'Toxxen Telemetry Barrel #TB547.' Strange, the barrel is filled entirely with oil. Haven't seen this much in one place since the shortage.
The signal is being sent to a chemical factory not far from here. This seems recent.. whoever did this might still be alive.
You found my tracking barrel? Brilliant! I was wondering why the pings stopped. It's part of my research, and I've stumbled onto something incredible!
BEHOLD: a new strain of bacteria I call 'Plasticeatis Intoilis.' Or just 'Polluted Goop.' It eats plastic! Metabolizes it! And what it leaves behind is Oil!
BACK into oil! Yes! I was testing different strains... but then the power cut out. Now I'm stuck! Take me with you, I'll give you everything my brain has to offer!
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Doctor_Cure_Line: Captain, a word? I appreciate the rescue, but I didn’t come aboard just to save myself.
When we left the hospital, I brought Disease Samples with me. Combined with my anti-bodies, I'd hoped they would lead me to a cure...
Hold up. You <size=110%>BROUGHT THE DISEASE</size> aboard??
Don't worry, I inactivated the virus. But the hospital's lab flooded before I could synthesize a cure. To finish the work, I'll need an Apothecary. Can you build one for me?
Perfect. In this Apothecary I can synthesize a cure for each pollution disease, from Smogbreath to Spongehead.
Glorious, bizarre, and exactly what we need. No time to waste, let's process these <sprite="SurvivalGuide_Sprites" sprite name="mushrooms"><color=#0DA3DC><b>Mushrooms<b></color>.
These Electric Eels are humming with energy, let's juice them before they fry something!
Musty, dusty and somehow still legible. Let's cut this Moldy Paper into small pieces for synthetization.
It worked! We've synthesized a cure! Captain, we've just made a giant leap towards a healthy future!
Now, we just need a way to safely administer the cure to the ill. Let's build a Med Pod, where patients can rest and recover during treatment.
Captain.. Thank you. You've given me the chance to keep doing what I was meant to do: save lives.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Doctor_DistressS: Feels good to have a purpose again.
That's disappointing. If you change your mind, I'll be here, ready to help.
This is Haven Hospital... We are in need of medical assistance... Patients in critical condition... Unknown illness resistant to known treatment... This is Haven Hospital...
It's a faint signal on a hospital's emergency responder frequency. There might still be someone there that can help us!
Survivors? If you came for a working hospital, I'm afraid you're too late. It's just me now.
Ah. You’re showing signs of Pollution Sickness. I'm sorry, it's resistant to conventional treatment. The medicine here won't help.
All those years dabbling with experimental medicine gave me immunity. Others.. weren't so lucky.
But maybe immunity wasn’t just a side effect. Maybe I've been blessed for a reason. Captain, if you’ll have me aboard, I'd like to help.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Electrician_Basi: Whewsa! You pulled me out just in time. This town's got some zing to it!
Hate to ask another favor, but getting eel-ectro shocked generated a hefty appetite. I could go for a-- Wait-wait-wait, you're still cooking with Firewood?!
Sorry, there's no way this puppy keeps up with my appetite. But I can earn my keep. I'll research the blueprints, then we'll wire up an Eel-ectric Grill!
Now we're cooking! Power up the grill and let's get feasting!
But... uh, my mouth's a little dry. Whaddya say we zap together an Eel-ectric Desalinator to keep the liquids flowing? Last request, promise!
That'll keep us hydrated, so long as the power's on.
Thanks for everything. I know I ask a lot, but now the whole town gets to benefit!
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Electrician_Dist: <shake>Ouch.. ow.. HELLO??</shake> Anyone out there?! This is {[CURRENT_SPEAKER]}, currently trapped inside an extremely overactive power plant! <shake>YOW!</shake> That zapped me!
Copy that. This is {[COMMUNITYNAME]}. We've got your location. Rescue inbound!
I COULD KISS AN ELECTRIC EEL RIGHT NOW! Please, bring Protective Gloves or we'll both be fried!
Ow-ow-ow yee-ouch!! Please, help! Electric Eels made a nest in the turbine intake. They are overcharging the systems.
It's a lightning zoo in there! We'll need Protective Gloves to get through safely.
<shake>HURRY!</shake> I don't think I can take much more of <shake>thi-ZZZZZZZ--</shake>
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Engineer_Basics_: Alright, what you need is something that carries part of the weight. A Town Tugger.
I'll research up a blueprint, but you gotta do your part and find me the resources to build the thing.
Solid frame, good guts. That's a mighty fine a Generator you've hauled in!
Good work, hot-shot. Now lets link it to the Townheart's Eel-ectricity Grid to spread out the energy load.
BOOM, problem solved! For now. If the town keeps growing, you'll need a few more of these. Good thing I came along.
Now, if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got robots to dream about and scrap to yell at.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Engineer_Distres: Easiest deal ever. Hope you got my bunk prepped!
This is the legendary {[CURRENT_SPEAKER]}, broadcasting from what's left of the world. System's shot, coffee's gone. If anyone's still out there... bring snacks.
{[COMMUNITYNAME]}? Never heard of it. Not surprised. Been stuck in this rust bucket for who-knows-how-long. Trying to fix my loneliness by BUILDING A ROBOT but THESE PARTS ARE TRASH!
We're a township! An actual town...SHIP! We're a moving town! We're looking for other survivors.
A moving town? Let me guess. You're low on power. You're hauling too much weight, and you've heard whispers of a <wave>legendary engineer</wave> who could fix it all? Yep, that's me.
Here’s my terms: rescue me from this hunk o' junk, feed me, water me, and give me a comfy bed to sleep on. Do that, and I’ll make your problems disappear. Sending my coordinates!
Welcome to The Rust Bucket! I'm ready to get the heck out of here, are you ready for me to fix your problems?
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Farmer_Basics_Li: Seems mighty backwards, crops not growin' in the middle of all this water. But the soil's been soaked in salt and tainted by acid rains. We'll have to make our own.
We need Bio-Waste and patience. Build me a Bio-Boiler, let’s see if we can breathe life back into this dirt.
I love the smell of fresh compost in the morning. 'Bout time we lay us down a Field.
There, that's oughta do it. Let's get to Potato planting.
Now, you can plant all you want. Nothin' on this green Earth grows without Fresh Water. Let's give 'em what they need and wait for them to grow.
Ahhh, smell that harvest. After everything, it's potatoes that make me smile again.
DIALOG_Quest_Specialist_Farmer_DistressS: S'pose I could lend a hand. Be good to see some green again.
Huh, that's a maintenance-distress ping. Might be something, or someone, trying to signal for help.
Holy fish gods, a Terraformer! Are those... pitchforks jammed into the vents? Geez, someone went ham on this thing.
Might have found the culprit, Captain. There's smoke coming from that farmhouse.
Whatever you're sellin', I ain't buyin'. I didn't need anyone before the flood, I sure as rot don't need anyone now.
Can’t you see? Blasted Terraformer turned this area into a sun-scorched playground for some rich ghost. No clouds. No rain. Just dust. Forever.
Used to grow potatoes here. Potatoes. The last crop to ever give up.
We've got a floating town. Could use someone who knows how to break soil. And machines.. when needed.
You looking to get yer hands dirty?
DIALOG_Quest_Start_Line002: Garbage floods washed away our village. Good thing we had our ship to make our escape!
DIALOG_Quest_Start_Line003: Let us not sink into despair. Let's ride this wave and stay afloat! WE'RE GOING TO SURVIVE! No,.. WE'RE GOING TO THRIVE!
DIALOG_Quest_Start_Line004: We should transform our boat into a floating community. Today we start rebuilding our civilization!
DIALOG_Quest_Start_Line005: But first, what should we christen our new town?
DIALOG_Quest_Start_Line006: {[COMMUNITYNAME]}, huh? Perfect! The future is ours!
DIALOG_Quest_Start_Line007: So, where do we even start with building this whole 'floating community' thing?
DIALOG_Quest_Start_Line008: Wait! Look at all this plastic floating around. It's like a precious floating gift of garbage. It's practically begging for a second chance. Begging! Let's put it to use.

DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_DrifterManagement_: As we take on more tasks, efficiency can drop without proper management. You can direct what gets done first by setting priorities for each Drifter's tasks.
These priorities are set in the Drifter Duties panel. You can open it by navigating through the {[RWRD:121]}panels.
These priorities are set in the Drifter Duties panel. Open it by pressing or use {[RWRD:57]}.
Drifters have affinity for certain tasks. They will be happier while doing them. Consider prioritizing these to keep your town happy!
Try changing a Drifter's priorities.
You can also manage Building Priorities. Drifters will work at higher-priority buildings of the same type before lower-priority ones. Try changing a workshop's priority.
Keep in mind that Drifters will always follow their Drifter Duties priorities first, before following the Building Priorities.
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Encounter_Tutorial: A BOAT! I can't believe it! I'm saved!
Why are you talking as if I'm not standing right here?
C-can I come aboard, please? I'm starving.
Alright, I'm going to just... come aboard now, yeah?
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_End_Line001: You've rescued a Drifter! {[COMMUNITYNAME]}'s newest inhabitant!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_End_Line001_0.9: Good job, Captain! You've found a survivor! {[COMMUNITYNAME]}'s newest inhabitant!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_End_Line002: Drifters often have interesting stories to share. They might know about valuable resources, other survivors, and more. You should talk to them!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_End_Line003: This rescue concludes the tutorial. Your town is now well on its way to becoming a thriving floating community!

DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_End_Line005: Feel free to continue this journey, or start anew. The choice is yours, captain!

DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective001_Line0: To do this, we're going to need some stable footing,.. Let's salvage some of that floating plastic over there!
Awesome! We can use the salvaged Floaters to extend and build our town.
To further extend our town, we'll need to repurpose the Plastic Waste into Floaters.
We can do this with a Plastic Recycler. Let's build one.
We can do this with a Plastic Workshop. Let's build one.
The Plastic Workshop is ready, Captain! Select it to begin production.
This isn't the right building, captain. Please select the Plastic Workshop.
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective001_Start: Now that we christened our town, let's start building it.
Alright! Let's get started on building our floating community!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective002_Line0: Now that we can make Floaters, we're one step closer to creating our floating community!
For the next step, we'll need more resources. Let's explore our surroundings and see what's out there.
Welcome to the Map! Here you can explore the world and move your town to another location.
Head to that Old Church. It seems like a good vantage point to scout the region from above.
Let's head to that patch of floating Wood over there! Seems like an ideal resource to build sturdier constructions.
Great! Now that we're here, you should close the Map.
And my, oh my, look at that Old Church—a relic of the old world, weathered but still standing after the flood. Let's select it.
And that is one wet wad of wood! Let's salvage it and process it into Refined resources.
In this panel, you can give various orders. Issue the order to scout to get a better view of our surroundings.
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective002_Wrong: This isn't the right landmark, captain. Please select the Old Church.
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective003_Line0: Whoa! We can see the entire region now!
It's heartbreaking seeing all those flooded houses. Makes you wonder what's left behind..
Let's check it out! Go to the landmarks and gather some Goods. Let's use them to turn this town into a warm and welcome home.
<wave>Let's check it out!</wave> Explore the landmarks and gather what we can. Let's use it to turn this town into a warm and welcome home.
Moldy, decrepit Junk from days gone by... beautiful! We can still make use of this. Let's recycle it into scrap first, then turn it into something useful.
Oh! A supermarket! Maybe there's some Food left!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective004_Line0: Ahh, it feels good to be properly settled in now!
Drifters with a home are happier, and happier Drifters gain more experience when doing tasks.
Drifters with a home are happier, and happier Drifters work and move faster. Which, in turn, makes them gain experience faster too.
But wow, now everyone's stomach is growling louder than a rabid garbage beaver. Let's quiet that down by getting some food in our bellies!
That's why keeping your Drifters happy is essential for a thriving town. Select a Drifter to check their Morale regularly to stay on top of their needs.
Gather some Seaweed out of the ocean, and whip up some quick and easy Seaweed Salad.
And you know what would really make me happy? Finding more stuff! I mean --uh, people! Obviously. Let's open the Map and see what's out there.
Before we can make Seaweed Salad, we'll need to build a Salad Spinner.
To do that, we'll need Wooden Planks. Salvage some Wet Wood from the ocean and let's figure out how to process it.
We got planks! Let's build that Salad Spinner and whip up some Seaweed Salad!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective004_WoodS: This Wet Wood needs a lot of work before we can build with it. Let's start by building a Manual Dryer and use it to dry it out.
We've got some Dry Wood, let's use it to build a Sawmill and start crafting some Wooden Planks!
We made Wooden Planks! Let's build ourselves some homes!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective005_Line0: It would be nice to have something to wash it down with... But, our Fresh Water supply seems to be running dry, lets refill it.

Good news: we're surrounded by water.
Bad news: it's all salty.
Let's chop some Firewood as well. We'll need it to desalinate the ocean water into drinkable water.
To make it drinkable, we’ll need to boil out the salt. Let’s get some Firewood and build a Desalinator.
We can get Firewood by recycling our Wood Junk in a Recycler, chop up Dry Wood at a Chopping Block, or find some at Woods landmarks.
We can get Firewood by chopping up Wood Junk or Dry Wood at a Chopping Block, or find some at Woods landmarks.
Desalinator: Check! Firewood: Check! Let's make some Fresh Water!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective006_Line0: Seems like we got our basic needs covered!
But if we're going to build a town that can truly support a community, we'll need to expand our Knowledge.
With Knowledge we can figure out how to maintain a sustainable food supply, improve our living conditions, generate Eel-ectricity, and more.
Knowledge is gained when drifters gain experience. Lucky for us, we’ve done quite a few tasks and gained plenty, lets put it to use!
Build a Research Station and research the Watch Tower. This will give us a better view of our surroundings as we look for others.
Let's build a Research Station and put our Knowledge to work!
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective007_Line0: Voila! We are all set to help other survivors and build our floating community together.
Let's venture onward and find a survivor. Rescue them and listen to their story!
Our best chance is to scout a region and hope we spot someone in the distance.
DIALOG_Quest_Tutorial_Objective008_Line0: This Canned Food will keep us fed for a few days, but if we want to survive, we'll need to be able to make our own food.
Oh! We already gathered some Seaweed out of the ocean, let's use it whip up some quick and easy Seaweed Salad.
We got a Salad Spinner! Let's whip up some Seaweed Salad.

LANDMARK_CityParkingGarage_Description: In another time, they left their precious little cars here. Tucked safely behind fences while their drivers enjoyed some me-time in the city.
LANDMARK_FarmlandPotatoes_Description: Back when the land turned sour, potatoes were the last crop still kicking. Now, weeds smother the fields, creeping over a last few forgotten spuds.
LANDMARK_FarmlandRuins_Description: This place was already abandoned long before the flood rolled in. Wrecked barns, rusty tools... still clinging to a time where the soil could provide.
LANDMARK_FarmlandTractors_Description: The fields are bare, but the old machines still offer a harvest of their own.
LANDMARK_FarmlandWindmill_Description: This windmill once harvested the wind while farmers harvested the earth. Now it stands broken, a retired worker staring at a soggy field.
LANDMARK_HardwareStore_Description: The shelves sag under the weight of mass-produced wrenches, hammers, and screwdrivers, each crafted just well enough to get the job done… once.
LANDMARK_Industry_AluminumWarehouse_Desc: Stacks of aluminum hoarded in a frenzy before the great flood. Everyone wanted a slice of the metal that could keep the government out of their thoughts.
LANDMARK_Industry_Drifter_Description: Using the machines’ dying warmth and whatever the conveyor belts yielded, they somehow survived the overwhelming smog.
LANDMARK_Industry_Factory_Plastic_Descri: Inside these factories, plastic flowed like a river, shaping treasures that now color the ocean.
LANDMARK_Industry_OilSilos_Description: A cluster of empty silos, nearly drained of every drop. By the time the shortage hit, people had turned the world’s black gold into mountains of disposable forks.
LANDMARK_Industry_Scout_Description: A chimney so tall it pierced the clouds, tainting a whole new layer of the atmosphere.
LANDMARK_PollutedWoods_ElectricityPylon_: Once carrying power between cities, it now looms over the grove as a reminder of the air that choked these woods. Its frame still makes a fine perch for spotting what lies beyond.
LANDMARK_Quest_Aquaculturist_Description: Some of these fish twist and grow in ways the world never intended.
LANDMARK_Quest_Astronaut_CrashSite_Descr: Scorched metal, smoke still rising, pieces scattered across the crater. The rocket crashed HARD. Its passenger and the Fusion Core might still be inside!
LANDMARK_Quest_Birdkeeper_Rescue_Descrip: This penthouse was built to be untouchable. And yet, seagulls sit in the pool like they own the place.
LANDMARK_Quest_Botanist_PlantGrove_Descr: The plants move like waves, dancing, vibing... Hypnotic. Strange. Alive.
LANDMARK_Quest_Cathedral_Description: The wall was perfect to keep out one wave. but the next one brought friends...
LANDMARK_Quest_Chef_FancyRestaurant_Desc: This restaurant was abandoned only recently, its kitchen full of half-finished experiments with strange, polluted fish.
LANDMARK_Quest_Chemist_Rescue_Descriptio: The lab hit a blackout. leaving the bubbling research suspended in a messy limbo.
LANDMARK_Quest_Electrician_Rescue_Descri: The plant is practically vibrating! Sparks fly from every pipe! Abandon at once, the eels rule this place now.
LANDMARK_Quest_Engineer_Rescue_Descripti: Amid stacks of crunched cars, a lone figure welded a robot from car and van parts.
LANDMARK_Quest_Farmer_Rescue_Description: Still standing, this farmhouse radiates a quiet, stubborn comfort.
LANDMARK_Quest_Farmer_Terraformer_Descri: Panels smashed, vents stuffed with pitchforks, wires everywhere. Someone went completely feral on this machine. It's dead, and so is the land.
LANDMARK_Quest_FishbaitShop_Description: Lucky for the worms, this bait shop was built just above the floodline.
LANDMARK_Quest_Hospital_Description: Soggy beds, murky white halls, and symptoms too weird to understand.
LANDMARK_Quest_RadioStation_Description: It reads: "Raw! Unfiltered! Interviewing one piece of trash at a time!"
LANDMARK_Quest_SewagePlant_Description: The pipes reek, the water is foul, yet the Holy Mackerel enjoys every stinking second.
LANDMARK_WoodsDeadTrees_Description: The skeletal remains of a thriving forest. Now just brittle sticks, pickled in salt. Maybe there's still a sliver of life left in their old bones, enough to help us survive another day.
LANDMARK_WoodsTrees_Description: A stubborn stand of trees that held on when everything washed away. Their wood builds our homes and keeps us warm, so we owe them: what we chop, we plant back.
Landmark_BasicIsland_Description: There appears to be a person in need of rescue! We should put them on a boat.
Landmark_BridgeIsland_Description: If we climb that wonky bridge we might find something useful at the end of it. Could see myself living here... if it didn't look like it could collapse any second now.
Landmark_CarIsland_Description: Damn metal wheel thingies. They had it coming! Clouding up our sunny sky. At least they help us survive now.
Landmark_City_ApartmentsGeneric_Descript: There must be way to get into those apartments for some relics of the past...
Landmark_City_DepartmentStore_Descriptio: Cheap furniture from big chains was all DIY. That saves us a ton of salvaging time!
Landmark_City_ElectricScrap_Description: Sparks are flying across those fuse boxes and cables. Better bring some gloves.
Landmark_City_Library_Description: Luckily most people returned their books on time before the flood, because of the high fines. The pages might be soaked and stuck together though...
Landmark_City_RooftopDrifterCamp_Descrip: Is that smoke coming from all the way up there? How did the rooftop dweller survive so long? What sights have unfolded before their salt-dried eyes?
Landmark_City_RooftopRestaurant_Descript: An exclusive dining experience, accessible solely through a submerged entrance. Let’s hope they have a non-seafood option.
Landmark_City_RooftopsGeneric_Descriptio: There's something shimmering on those rooftops. There must be valuable trinkets and treasures up there!
Landmark_City_Skyscraper_Description: A massive building that towers over the flooded city. Quite the workout without an elevator... but the view is worth it.
Landmark_City_SolarPanels_Description: A patchwork of panels reflects the sunlight atop the crumbling roof, these weathered devices could prove handy in our journey.
Landmark_City_Supermarket_Description: We still got some coupons from the last supermarket. It’s unlikely anyone will check the expiration date.
Landmark_DrifterCamp_Description: There's smoke coming from this island. There might be some drifters here!
Landmark_Farmlands_Generic_Description: These farms lie overgrown and untamed. Perhaps we could still find some precious seeds to harvest among the tangled vines.
Landmark_Highway_Gasstation_Description: If we act quick, we can prevent this gas station from leaking gasoline into the ocean. We could use some for our engines too...
Landmark_Highway_Generic_Description: This road managed to stay dry. There are metal contraptions escaping the flood on top of it. Let's get dismantling.
Landmark_Highway_OilTanker_Description: A lone tanker sits stranded between the wreckages. We might be able to siphon some oil!
Landmark_Highway_ViaductTruck_Descriptio: Wow that's a big one! Imagine what we could build with all that scrap.
Landmark_Industry_FactoryRuins_Descripti: Some say these ruins could fill the sky with dark clouds. We could learn a thing or two from them if we study the relics inside. Could have some oil in them as well.
Landmark_PollutedWoods_Deadforest_Descri: Pollution withered a whole forest. Maybe once cut, it will grow back someday.
Landmark_PollutedWoods_Drifter_Descripti: Another lonely soul tried making a home with driftwood...
Landmark_PollutedWoods_FishingShacks_Des: Looks like an abandoned fishing village. If they had any fish it's probably spoiled, but maybe we can find some other stuff in there.
Landmark_PollutedWoods_Forest_Descriptio: These trees seem to be withered from the water contamination...  We should replant these at some point.
Landmark_PollutedWoods_LookoutTower_Desc: This tower should give a breathtaking view of the surrounding islands. It's sticking out just above the tree line.
Landmark_PollutedWoods_Mushrooms_Descrip: Healing mushrooms! Just hold your breath for the toxic air, don't get step on poisonous plants and avoid direct contact with skin. Easy.
Landmark_PollutedWoods_Road_Description: Cars put smoke in the air and trees pull it back out. The perfect cycle.
Landmark_PollutedWoods_ShackTown_Descrip: There appears to be a small abandoned town on this island. We might find some supplies in there. Pretty sure nobody will miss them.
Landmark_Rural_Bookshop_Description:
There's a papery smell in the air!
We might find some old manuscripts containing secrets of life in the old world.
Landmark_Rural_Church_Description: Someone in that bell tower would be all-seeing and all-knowing, of the directly surrounding area.
Landmark_Rural_ElectricShop_Description: Is this where people used to buy their electricity, their eels, or both?
Landmark_Rural_GenericShops_Description: Could there be some unlooted shops among those ruins?
Landmark_Rural_GroceryShop_Description: These small shops sometimes have leftover cans, jars or other food that lasts forever, if you look where nobody else looked first.
Landmark_Rural_Highway_Description: The highway leads through a village here. Vehicle garbage meets human garbage.
Landmark_Rural_MetalShop_Description: Why did people buy metal here, when it's available for free on the roads and in the water everywhere... Well, it's free for us now.
Landmark_Rural_Pharmacy_Description: Lucky for us, nobody thought looting medicine for diseases like Oilyosis or Spongehead was worth it.
Landmark_Rural_Restaurant_Description: Looks like non-perishable canned food is back on the menu, boys.
Landmark_Rural_Supermarket_Description: The shelves are empty and the aisles are covered in debris. Toilet paper and soap is all gone, but some more tasteless food can still be found perhaps.
Landmark_Rural_Trees_Description: Nature is in progress of reclaiming these ruins. It won't miss a few blocks of wood right?
Landmark_Rural_VillageRuins_Description: It's not breaking and entering if there's holes all over the houses! Scavenging time!
Landmark_Rural_WaterSilo_Description: That huge barrel towering over that village is leaking water! The unquenchable thirst is finally over! Fill up the reservoirs boys...
Landmark_Salvage_GasStation: Extract gasoline from gas station pumps
Landmark_Salvage_OilTrailer: Pump gasoline from oil tank truck
Landmark_Scout_Description: From here we will be able to scout all the Landmarks in this region.
Landmark_ScoutingTower_Description: There must be a fantastic view of the surrounding area up there. Let's climb up!
Landmark_SeaweedIsland_Description: There's a bunch of nature we could take with us over on them green rocks. Could be slippery. Watch your step!
Landmark_Viaduct_Description: Look at that concrete island over here. Those beached metal manatees could be dismantled to make our next buildings.
Landmark_Warning_Boat: You need a salvage boat to be able to reach this landmark.
Landmark_Wreckage_MetalShipwreck_Descrip: An island where some boat wreckages landed.
Landmark_Wreckage_OilTanker_Description: Huge ships like this usually have some oil leftovers in their engines. Hopefully not too much of it got spilled in the ocean...
Landmark_Wreckage_OvergrownWoodShip_Desc: Oh look at that! The trees are already reclaiming those ships! Perhaps we can do some reclaiming of our own without disturbing them too much.
Landmark_Wreckage_WaterOasis_Description: Woop! The rain got trapped in here. Should be drinkable enough. Fill up the reservoirs!

SurvivalGuide_Attributes_Content_01:
Each drifter has attributes.
This affects how effectively they perform tasks.

Drifter stories determine the starting attribute points.
Attributes can be affected by various means.
SurvivalGuide_BuoyMarkers_Content_01: Markers are your tools for getting items out of the water. Placing them will send drifters to collect resources within the displayed range.
SurvivalGuide_BuoyMarkers_Content_03: A marker that gets drifters to swim to it. This one can only be placed within swimming distance of your townheart.
SurvivalGuide_BuoyMarkers_Content_05: A marker that is limited to drifters with salvage boats. The range of this one is unlimited.
SurvivalGuide_BuoyMarkers_Content_07: A marker that can only be used on fish schools. Drifters with a fishing boat can fish here.
SurvivalGuide_Energy_Content_01:
Eel-ectricity is a resource that is used for
- <style="SGLink><link="townmovement">Moving the town</link></style>
- As fuel for an Eel-ectricity consumer
SurvivalGuide_Energy_Content_08: Eel-ectricity suppliers produce energy by consuming various resources.
SurvivalGuide_Energy_Content_10: Any building that consumes energy is an Eel-ectricity Consumer. If the grid consumption rate is higher than the grid production rate, Eel-ectricity consumers will work at reduced efficiency.
SurvivalGuide_Energy_Content_12: Generated Eel-ectricity can be stored into Eel-ectricity storage constructions. Each Battery has a maximum amount of Eel-ectricity that can be stored. Connecting Eel-ectricity storage increases the maximum storage-able amount for that grid. If there is surplus power on a grid, the Eel-ectricity Storage will charge. Eel-ectricity Storage is charged evenly over a grid. (e.g if there are three Eel-ectricity storages, the charging is evenly distributed among all three)
SurvivalGuide_Energy_Content_14: Eel-ectricity grids are collections of connected Eel-ectricity consumers and Eel-ectricity suppliers by an Eel-ectricity Pole. (e.g if a Manual-Powered Generator and one Food Truck are connected, it is a grid)
SurvivalGuide_Energy_Content_15: Each Supplier has a Threshold. When the total energy of the connected energy grid falls below that threshold, the supplier will fully charge the connected energy storages.
SurvivalGuide_Expertise_Content_01: As drifters level up, they gain Expertise by increasing their attributes.
SurvivalGuide_Knowledge_Content_01: <sprite="SurvivalGuide_Sprites" sprite name="knowledge"> Knowledge is a resource used for research.
SurvivalGuide_Knowledge_Content_02: Term_Knowledge is obtained when drifters gain experience. Happier drifters gain more experience. Knowledge is required for researching new technologies.
SurvivalGuide_Landmarks_Content_01: Remnants of the old world can be found in the ocean around you. If your town is close enough, your drifters can visit these and interact with them. Every landmark has different gains. Boats will increase the interaction range.
SurvivalGuide_Landmarks_Content_04: Drifters can salvage resources from landmarks. If your town is within range, you can send a chosen amount of drifters to gather these.
SurvivalGuide_Landmarks_Content_06: When somebody is in dire need, you can save them! (Please do.)
SurvivalGuide_Morale_Content_01: Drifters have different Morale states which affect their levelling speed.
SurvivalGuide_Morale_Content_03: As drifters level up, their morale need increases. Keeping these needs met will result in happy drifters.
SurvivalGuide_Morale_Content_04: Drifter Morale can be affected by various modifiers. Some of these modifiers, like hunger and thirst, reduce drifter attributes.
SurvivalGuide_Needs_Content_01:
A drifter needs Water, Food and Sleep to function at the best of their abilities. If not met, drifters will suffer debuffs in various stages, eventually leading to death.

Don’t worry. They will automatically take care of their own needs whenever possible.
SurvivalGuide_Needs_Content_03:
Hunger can be fulfilled by eating food. Without food, drifters will become hungry in various stages, eventually leading to death.

Each stage gives a hunger debuff. Hunger debuffs lower a drifter’s Nautics and Construction attributes. The attributes decrease more per stage of hunger. If a drifter reaches the stage after Severe Hunger, they will die of malnourishment.
SurvivalGuide_Needs_Content_05:
Thirst can be fulfilled by drinking water. Water is the primary drifter need. Without water, drifters will become thirsty in various stages, eventually leading to death.

Each stage gives a thirst debuff. Thirst debuffs lower all drifter attributes. The attributes decrease more per stage of thirst. If a drifter reaches the stage after Severe Thirst, they will die of dehydration.
SurvivalGuide_Needs_Content_07:
Rest can be restored by sleeping in good conditions. Drifters that slept on the walkways or have disturbed sleep will not have slept well.

Without good sleep, drifters will become tired in various stages. Severe and Maddening exhaustion gives debuffs. Tiredness debuffs lower Athletics and Research attributes. The attributes decrease more per stage of tiredness. Drifters can not die due to sleep deprivation.
SurvivalGuide_Pollution_Content_1: Food resources have a varying level of pollution in them. This pollution affects your drifters' health. By cleaning fish or finding food on landmarks, this can be improved. This pollution level is shown on the item tooltip and in the crafting window.
SurvivalGuide_Pollution_Content_2: The health of drifters will decrease each time they eat polluted food. Drifters will become diseased if their pollution level bar is full. Diseased drifters will need to sleep to get rid of their disease. This process takes about a day, during which the drifter won't be able to do any tasks.
SurvivalGuide_Pollution_Content_3: Polluted food resources can be cleaned in various buildings, such as: - Unbottler - Fishwasher These cleaned versions of food allow you to use better recipes in cooking buildings. These in turn will make your drifters less sick. These food recipes have lower pollution levels than cooking just the raw resource. (e.g Drying the Bottle Fish after unbottling it in the Unbottler will reduce the pollution level)
SurvivalGuide_Resources_Annotation_01: Flotsam is the maritime name given to items floating on the water.
SurvivalGuide_TownMovement_Content_01: You can move the town by going to the Map. Here, you can click on a spot to move to it. This will have an energy requirement. A destination needs to be at a minimum distance equal to the Town Radius away from any landmark on the Map.
SurvivalGuide_TownMovement_Content_03: The town weight is expressed in tiers.
SurvivalGuide_TownMovement_Content_04: The tier of town weight is calculated by the total accumulation of all resource weights in construction costs, inventories and in storage. Each level has a threshold, once the total weight goes above it, the town will be in a higher weight tier. Each tier affects the energy costs for town movement.
